name: User Ratings 1.0.2.0, the Data tab in the TV layout: in the default sandbox as admin in jellyfin-web 10.11.5's TV layout: the Data tab and the detached list have no select; OK on a choice picks it (Replace, then Merge again); Down and Up walk the tab (Export, the file field, Merge and back, then the Data tab above it), and Down from the last Restore… stays in the tab, never the dashboard's drawer; OK on Restore… opens its question with the focus on Cancel; Down past the last control and Up past the first keep the focus inside it (no wrap, no way out); Back (keyCode 461) closes it with the focus back on that Restore… and the page where it was; OK on Cancel closes it the same way; OK on a reason of the detached list reads the list for it, and on "Every reason" again; nothing is written and the snapshots are as before the run.

steps.name: the details probe in every document (its request log and server())
the served script is 1.0.2.0
steps.message: User Ratings 1.0.2.0 is not the script the page loaded

steps.name: before the run: the snapshots as the server holds them
steps.script: const r = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots'); if (r.status !== 200) { throw new Error('snapshots ' + r.status); } return r.json.Snapshots.map(s => s.Name).sort();

steps.name: the Data tab mounted: the snapshots, the users and the jobs read, and the detached list
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = __jfurDetails.requests.slice(window.__mark); const got = (p) => r.some(x => x.method === 'GET' && x.path === p && x.status === 200); return !document.querySelector('#UserRatingsData').classList.contains('hide') && !!document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-export') && !!document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDetachedListRoot .jfur-det') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Diagnostics') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Jobs') && got('/UserRatings/Admin/Detached'); })()

steps.name: the time the lists take to draw
GETs only (and the page's own Detached/Seen): opening the tab writes nothing
no select in the Data tab or the detached list (the TV layout's D-pad and OK work on every control)
the sandbox has a snapshot to offer Restore… on
steps.message: no snapshot in the sandbox yet: run userratings-data-desktop.json (or any import) first

steps.name: tv: the Replace choice focused
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot [role=radio][data-jfur-value="Replace"]'); b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b;

steps.name: tv: the Merge choice focused
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot [role=radio][data-jfur-value="Merge"]'); b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b;

steps.name: tv: Export focused
steps.script: const b = document.querySelector('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-export'); b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b;

steps.name: tv: what has the focus after Down

steps.script: const all = document.querySelectorAll('#UserRatingsDataRoot .jfur-data-restore'); const b = all[all.length - 1]; b.focus(); return document.activeElement === b;

steps.script: const r = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Snapshots'); const now = r.json.Snapshots.map(s => s.Name).sort(); if (JSON.stringify(now) !== JSON.stringify(__vars.snapsBefore)) { throw new Error('the snapshots changed: ' + JSON.stringify(now)); } return now.length;
